name: Tamara

hero.name: Tamara
hero.lede: I cut long podcast episodes into vertical clips built to hold attention past the three-second mark. Twenty seconds on why that might be worth your time. Sound optional.

offer.headline: I turn your episodes into clips that get watched.
offer.sub: Send me the raw episode. Get back vertical clips that hold attention past the three-second mark: hooked, captioned, and ready to post.

_placeholderNote: Clips are hosted on YouTube. The site stores no clip video. Fill youtubeId (the 11-char id from the watch/shorts URL) plus metric and retention from your analytics. A clip with an empty youtubeId renders a PLACEHOLDER tile. Never ship invented metrics.

clips.title: Vaping might be worse than smoking

captionStyles.name: Karaoke
captionStyles.note: Word lights up on the beat. Highest retention, busiest look.

captionStyles.name: Block
captionStyles.note: Two words, heavy weight, hard cuts. Reads fast on a phone.

captionStyles.name: Clean
captionStyles.note: One line, bottom third. For shows that want less noise.

captionStyles.name: Emphasis
captionStyles.note: Neutral line, one word punched. Points without shouting.

intake: Send the raw episode. Video or audio, any format.
Tell me the show, the audience, and where you post.
I pick the moments and send clips for review.

about.lead: A year and a half in DaVinci Resolve, self-taught.
about.body: My focus is short-form vertical storytelling, cuts built to hold attention from the first frame. I also build motion graphics for landscape, and cut montages and speed ramps when a piece calls for it.

clipsSection.heading: The work
clipsSection.sub: Talking-head and long-form content cut down to vertical. Every tile says what it is and what it did.

motionSection.heading: Motion graphics
motionSection.sub: Not the main offer. Here so you know the ceiling if your show needs titles, lower thirds or a sting.
